column3: “Recovery” renders becoming strong; “Hezekiah” identifies the unstated subject of illness.
“The envoys” identifies the pronoun; “palace” specifies house.
The two questions are presented in reverse order.
“Palace” specifies house; “Isaiah” identifies the unstated speaker.
“The time” replaces coming days; “palace” specifies house.
“Your own flesh and blood” replaces the clauses about coming forth from him and being begotten by him.
“He thought” replaces “he said”; “at least” is supplied.
